title: Project: Perplexa Chat
text:
Perplexa Chat (Dec 2024 – Apr 2025, AI/ML): AI-powered RAG-based search assistant.
Problem: Searching across large, unstructured knowledge bases (10,000+ document entries) was slow and imprecise, with no way to ask natural-language questions over the corpus.
Solution: Designed and launched a Streamlit-based RAG application used by 50+ testers, integrating MongoDB vector embeddings with GenAI APIs and a real-time retrieval pipeline with an optimized chunking strategy — cutting query response time by 40% and improving search usability by 60%.
Learnings: Chunking strategy has an outsized effect on retrieval quality and latency; Vector search performance at 10k+ document scale requires deliberate indexing choices; Fast user feedback loops (50+ testers) surfaced UX gaps a solo build would have missed.
Tech: Python, Streamlit, MongoDB, Vector Embeddings, RAG, GenAI APIs.
Source: https://github.com/Shubhampatel001/Perplexa
Live demo: https://perplexa.streamlit.app/

title: Project: EvoDrive
text:
EvoDrive (Jul 2024 – Nov 2024, AI/ML): Genetic algorithm for autonomous driving.
Problem: Autonomous navigation in a simulated environment needed to learn obstacle avoidance and efficient pathfinding without hand-coded rules for every scenario.
Solution: Engineered a driving simulation that reached 90% obstacle-avoidance accuracy through iterative genetic algorithm optimization across 200+ training generations, then integrated Dijkstra's algorithm to cut pathfinding computation time by 30% and improve route efficiency and stability.
Learnings: Genetic algorithms converge unevenly — generation count matters less than fitness function design; Combining a classical algorithm (Dijkstra) with an evolutionary one can outperform either alone; Simulation stability across variable test environments is its own engineering problem.
Tech: Python, Genetic Algorithms, Dijkstra's Algorithm, Simulation.
Source: https://github.com/Shubhampatel001/EvoDrive-Genetic-Algorithm-for-Autonomous-Driving
Live demo: https://shubhampatel001.github.io/EvoDrive-Genetic-Algorithm-for-Autonomous-Driving/

title: Project: Flappy Bird with NEAT
text:
Flappy Bird with NEAT (Jan 2024 – May 2024, AI/ML): Neuro-evolution agent that learns to play.
Problem: Teaching an agent to play Flappy Bird with zero human input after training, using an evolving neural network rather than fixed rules.
Solution: Developed an AI agent using the NEAT neuro-evolution algorithm, increasing fitness scores by 150% over 500 generations through systematic parameter tuning and network topology optimization — reaching fully autonomous gameplay after just 40 generations.
Learnings: Topology evolution (not just weight tuning) accelerated convergence significantly; Fitness scoring design directly shapes what behavior actually evolves; 40 generations was enough for competence; 500 kept refining margins.
Tech: Python, NEAT Algorithm, Neuro-evolution, Pygame.
Source: https://github.com/Shubhampatel001/Flappy-Bird-With-NEAT-Algorithm

README: EvoDrive - Genetic Algorithm for Autonomous Driving 🚗💡 EvoDrive is a project that combines genetic algorithms with advanced simulation techniques to create a pseudo-3D autonomous driving environment. Initially inspired by NEAT (NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies), our project has evolved into a broader implementation of genetic algorithms for self-driving car simulations. This project demonstrates the use of AI to handle tasks such as obstacle avoidance, shortest path navigation, and dynamic world interaction. --- Table of Contents - Project Overview - Features - Technologies Used - How It Works - Installation - Challenges Faced - Future Plans --- Project Overview EvoDrive aims to simulate the following features in a dynamic environment: 1. Autonomous driving using genetic algorithms for evolutionary learning. 2. Handling stationary and moving obstacles in a realistic road setup. 3. Building a pseudo-3D environment with interactive elements such as traffic lights and road signs. 4. Dynamic route selection and shortest path computation using algorithms like Dijkstra’s. 5. Real-time visualization of neural network decisions. --- Features Core Functionalities - Genetic Algorithm for AI Evolution : Mutation-based learning for car decision-making. - Obstacle Detection and Avoidance : Sensors simulate real-world proximity detection. - Shortest Path Navigation : Implementation

To watch the AI agent train itself: Open the "NEAT Algo Flappy Bird.ipynb" notebook. Run the cells to train the NEAT algorithm and observe the AI gameplay. To watch the AI agent play: Run python python test.py Notes Ensure that you have Python and Jupyter Notebook installed on your system before running the notebooks.
